title: Repair Telegram interaction protocol and evidence
requirements: Repair TG-004 before any orchestration. The fixed callback matcher must accept only v1:o, v1:h, v1:r and v1:u; bare v1:s must return typed MALFORMED_CALLBACK and never KeyError. For service selection accept only v1:s:<catalog_version>:<option_ordinal> with canonical decimal text: catalog 1..2147483647, ordinal 0..2147483647, no sign, whitespace, leading zero except ordinal zero, missing/extra segment, non-ASCII digit or overflow. Known o/h/r/u/s shapes with malformed extra/missing data are MALFORMED_CALLBACK; unknown action such as v1:x and unknown version such as v2:o are UNSUPPORTED_CALLBACK.

Treat AcceptedTelegramUpdate as untrusted construction despite its source boundary. Require exact type, a validate_context-approved TELEGRAM context, and one exact shape: TEXT has normalized non-empty text of at most 4096 characters, no data and no callback_query_id; CALLBACK has no text, non-empty data of at most 64 UTF-8 bytes and a normalized non-empty callback_query_id of at most 256 characters. Reject every other shape with INVALID_UPDATE, INVALID_CONTEXT or MALFORMED_UPDATE as appropriate. Catch only the expected GatewayError from context validation, not broad Exception.

Preserve the exact trusted context object, exact ordinary text and exact callback_query_id in returned intents. Keep payload MappingProxyType immutable and TelegramIntent frozen. TelegramInteractionError str/repr must be stable and contain neither supplied command/callback/text nor trusted identifiers.

Replace the single broad test with direct parameterized coverage: wrong object/exact-type/context/platform and every malformed TEXT/CALLBACK combination; immutability and identity preservation; /start,/help,/reset case variants and accepted username suffix; arguments, outer whitespace, lookalikes and every unknown slash command; arbitrary non-command Unicode text; all four fixed callbacks; bare v1:s; all service numeric boundaries; leading zeros, signs, spaces, Unicode digits, missing/extra/non-numeric/overflow fields; unknown actions/versions; raw service id, JSON and spoof payloads. Assert exact intent kinds/payloads or exact typed error codes and prove no implementation exception escapes.

Copy this exact contract from primary .pipeline/TG-005-spec.json to tasks/specs/TG-005.json. Do not call conversation, resolve a catalog, add copy, transport, HTTP, SDK, persistence, environment, logging, delivery, retry or external behavior.
acceptance: Every accepted callback follows the compact canonical v1 protocol and malformed callbacks cannot raise implementation exceptions or smuggle raw business identifiers.
Only a structurally valid trusted Telegram update can produce an immutable intent, with direct evidence for every TG-004 branch and boundary.
Focused interaction tests, Telegram update regression, complete project tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Required correctness and evidence repair for the Telegram intent trust boundary before it can drive the shared conversation.
